blocks.title: A Healing Tongue is a Tree of Life

texts.NIV84: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
texts.KJV: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
texts.NKJV:
A soft answer turns away wrath,
But a harsh word stirs up anger.
texts.DRB: A mild answer breaketh wrath: but a harsh word stirreth up fury.

texts.NIV84: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool gushes folly.
texts.KJV: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
texts.NKJV:
The tongue of the wise uses knowledge rightly,
But the mouth of fools pours forth foolishness.
texts.DRB: The tongue of the wise adorneth knowledge: but the mouth of fools bubbleth out folly.

texts.NIV84: The eyes of the LORD are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good.
texts.KJV: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
texts.NKJV:
The eyes of the Lord are in every place,
Keeping watch on the evil and the good.
texts.DRB: The eyes of the Lord in every place behold the good and the evil.

texts.NIV84: The tongue that brings healing is a tree of life, but a deceitful tongue crushes the spirit.
texts.KJV: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
texts.NKJV:
A wholesome tongue is a tree of life,
But perverseness in it breaks the spirit.
texts.DRB: A peaceable tongue is a tree of life: but that which is immoderate, shall crush the spirit.

texts.NIV84: A fool spurns his father's discipline, but whoever heeds correction shows prudence.
texts.KJV: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
texts.NKJV:
A fool despises his father’s instruction,
But he who receives correction is prudent.
texts.DRB: A fool laugheth at the instruction of his father: but he that regardeth reproofs shall become prudent. In abundant justice there is the greatest strength: but the devices of the wicked shall be rooted out.

texts.NIV84: The house of the righteous contains great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings them trouble.
texts.KJV: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
texts.NKJV:
In the house of the righteous there is much treasure,
But in the revenue of the wicked is trouble.
texts.DRB: The house of the just is very much strength: and in the fruits of the wicked is trouble.

texts.NIV84: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so the hearts of fools.
texts.KJV: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
texts.NKJV:
The lips of the wise disperse knowledge,
But the heart of the fool does not do so.
texts.DRB: The lips of the wise shall disperse knowledge: the heart of fools shall be unlike.

texts.NIV84: The LORD detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him.
texts.KJV: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
texts.NKJV:
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord,
But the prayer of the upright is His delight.
texts.DRB: The victims of the wicked are abominable to the Lord: the vows of the just are acceptable.

texts.NIV84: The LORD detests the way of the wicked but he loves those who pursue righteousness.
texts.KJV: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
texts.NKJV:
The way of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord,
But He loves him who follows righteousness.
texts.DRB: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: he that followeth justice is beloved by him.

texts.NIV84: Stern discipline awaits him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.
texts.KJV: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
texts.NKJV:
Harsh discipline is for him who forsakes the way,
And he who hates correction will die.
texts.DRB: Instruction is grievous to him that forsaketh the way of life: he that hateth reproof shall die.

texts.NIV84: Death and Destruction lie open before the LORD - how much more the hearts of men!
texts.KJV: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
texts.NKJV:
Hell and Destruction are before the Lord;
So how much more the hearts of the sons of men.
texts.DRB: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more the hearts of the children of men?

texts.NIV84: A mocker resents correction; he will not consult the wise.
texts.KJV: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
texts.NKJV:
A scoffer does not love one who corrects him,
Nor will he go to the wise.
texts.DRB: A corrupt man loveth not one that reproveth him: nor will he go to the wise.

texts.NIV84: A happy heart makes the face cheerful, but heartache crushes the spirit.
texts.KJV: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
texts.NKJV:
A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance,
But by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
texts.DRB: A glad heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by grief of mind the spirit is cast down.

texts.NIV84: The discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.
texts.KJV: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
texts.NKJV:
The heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge,
But the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.
texts.DRB: The heart of the wise seeketh instruction: and the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

texts.NIV84: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.
texts.KJV: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
texts.NKJV:
All the days of the afflicted are evil,
But he who is of a merry heart has a continual feast.
texts.DRB: All the days of the poor are evil: a secure mind is like a continual feast.

texts.NIV84: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great wealth with turmoil.
texts.KJV: Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble therewith.
texts.NKJV:
Better is a little with the fear of the Lord,
Than great treasure with trouble.
texts.DRB: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord, than great treasures without content,

texts.NIV84: Better a meal of vegetables where there is love than a fattened calf with hatred.
texts.KJV: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
texts.NKJV:
Better is a dinner of herbs where love is,
Than a fatted calf with hatred.
texts.DRB: It is better to be invited to herbs with love, than to a fatted calf with hatred.

blocks.title: The Way of Life Winds Upward

texts.NIV84: A hot-tempered man stirs up dissension, but a patient man calms a quarrel.
texts.KJV: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
texts.NKJV:
A wrathful man stirs up strife,
But he who is slow to anger allays contention.
texts.DRB: A passionate man stirreth up strifes: he that is patient appeaseth those that are stirred up.

texts.NIV84: The way of the sluggard is blocked with thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.
texts.KJV: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
texts.NKJV:
The way of the lazy man is like a hedge of thorns,
But the way of the upright is a highway.
texts.DRB: The way of the slothful is as a hedge of thorns; the way of the just is without offence.

texts.NIV84: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.
texts.KJV: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
texts.NKJV:
A wise son makes a father glad,
But a foolish man despises his mother.
texts.DRB: A wise son maketh a father joyful: but the foolish man despiseth his mother.

texts.NIV84: Folly delights a man who lacks judgment, but a man of understanding keeps a straight course.
texts.KJV: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
texts.NKJV:
Folly is joy to him who is destitute of discernment,
But a man of understanding walks uprightly.
texts.DRB: Folly is joy to the fool: and the wise man maketh straight his steps.

texts.NIV84: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
texts.KJV: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
texts.NKJV:
Without counsel, plans go awry,
But in the multitude of counselors they are established.
texts.DRB: Designs are brought to nothing where there is no counsel: but where there are many counsellors, they are established.

texts.NIV84: A man finds joy in giving an apt reply- and how good is a timely word!
texts.KJV: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
texts.NKJV:
A man has joy by the answer of his mouth,
And a word spoken in due season, how good it is!
texts.DRB: A man rejoiceth in the sentence of his mouth: and a word in due time is best.

texts.NIV84: The path of life leads upward for the wise to keep him from going down to the grave.
texts.KJV: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
texts.NKJV:
The way of life winds upward for the wise,
That he may turn away from hell below.
texts.DRB: The path of life is above for the wise, that he may decline from the lowest hell.

blocks.title: The Heart of The Righteous Studies

texts.NIV84: The LORD tears down the proud man's house but he keeps the widow's boundaries intact.
texts.KJV: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
texts.NKJV:
The Lord will destroy the house of the proud,
But He will establish the boundary of the widow.
texts.DRB: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: and will strengthen the borders of the widow.

texts.NIV84: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but those of the pure are pleasing to him.
texts.KJV: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
texts.NKJV:
The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord,
But the words of the pure are pleasant.
texts.DRB: Evil thoughts are an abomination to the Lord: and pure words most beautiful shall be confirmed by him.

texts.NIV84: A greedy man brings trouble to his family, but he who hates bribes will live.
texts.KJV: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
texts.NKJV:
He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house,
But he who hates bribes will live.
texts.DRB: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house: but he that hateth bribes shall live. By mercy and faith sins are purged away: and by the fear of the Lord every one declineth from evil.

texts.NIV84: The heart of the righteous weighs its answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes evil.
texts.KJV: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
texts.NKJV:
The heart of the righteous studies how to answer,
But the mouth of the wicked pours forth evil.
texts.DRB: The mind of the just studieth obedience: the mouth of the wicked over floweth with evils.

texts.NIV84: The LORD is far from the wicked but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
texts.KJV: The Lord is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
texts.NKJV:
The Lord is far from the wicked,
But He hears the prayer of the righteous.
texts.DRB: The Lord is far from the wicked: and he will hear the prayers of the just.

texts.NIV84: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart, and good news gives health to the bones.
texts.KJV: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
texts.NKJV:
The light of the eyes rejoices the heart,
And a good report makes the bones healthy.
texts.DRB: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the soul: a good name maketh the bones fat.

texts.NIV84: He who listens to a life-giving rebuke will be at home among the wise.
texts.KJV: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
texts.NKJV:
The ear that hears the rebukes of life
Will abide among the wise.
texts.DRB: The ear that heareth the reproofs of life, shall abide in the midst of the wise.

texts.NIV84: He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.
texts.KJV: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
texts.NKJV:
He who disdains instruction despises his own soul,
But he who heeds rebuke gets understanding.
texts.DRB: He that rejecteth instruction, despiseth his own soul: but he that yieldeth to reproof possesseth understanding.

texts.NIV84: The fear of the LORD teaches a man wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
texts.KJV: The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
texts.NKJV:
The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom,
And before honor is humility.
texts.DRB: The fear of the Lord is the lesson of wisdom: and humility goeth before glory.
